summary: Seven tabs in a narrow container where the list scrolls horizontally with edge fades.
use: Settings areas with more sections than fit the width, especially on mobile.
spec: `<TabsList fade>` over `{#each sections as s (s)}` producing `TabsTrigger` items
`const sections` has 7 labels: General, Billing, Members, Webhooks, Security, Integrations, Danger zone
`<Tabs value="integrations">` starts on the sixth tab
Values come from `const key = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')`
